pre_run_static_correction.reason: Independent static review found that CY-006 legally represents an optional no-rights value as either true null or finite zero, while the first unexecuted runner draft required finite zero. The same review found a nullable-boolean fail-open risk and an opportunity-failure publication mismatch.
pre_run_static_correction.versioning_decision: Retain V35 identity because no source access, count, candidate population, result or authorization existed under the withdrawn draft. Git history preserves the superseded bytes.

purpose: Test only whether the minimum cash ticket implied by the supported A-share 100-share board lot yields a sufficiently broad, causally observable and non-obviously-duplicate pre-2021 mother population. Stage A may count frozen identities and inspect contemporaneous or prior-only redundancy geometry; it may not attach any future path, fill, return, target, exit, chart outcome or portfolio field.
economic_hypothesis: Without fractional shares, a lower 100-share cash ticket can admit a broader marginal retail clientele. Among liquid firms in the same PIT industry and the middle circulating-size tercile, the lowest-ticket stock may receive broader attention and demand. The frozen direction is LOWER_TICKET_BETTER. Failure cannot be rescued by reversing to high-ticket stocks.

representation_boundary.board_lot_ticket_cny: 100 * raw completed-close CNY/share on signal session t
representation_boundary.mathematical_identity: This is exactly nominal raw price scaled by the supported 100-share lot. It is not claimed to add mathematical information beyond nominal price.
representation_boundary.not_low_max: No return, MAX, momentum or path field selects a candidate. Prior-20 MAX is calculated only as an outcome-blind redundancy diagnostic after identity selection.
representation_boundary.not_size: Circulating market value is used only to form the within-industry middle tercile. The lowest or highest circulating-size stock cannot enter the rankable pool.
representation_boundary.not_liquidity: Same-date amount provides one fixed executability floor. Amount, turnover and volume never determine the ticket ordering.
representation_boundary.not_corporate_action_alpha: Raw current price is the economically quoted ticket coordinate. Signal-day corporate actions are excluded; no split, distribution, supply event or adjusted price defines the signal.
representation_boundary.claim_limit: No investor-account, holdings, order-flow, wealth or true clientele field exists. Passing Stage A establishes only representation and opportunity readiness.

registry.policy: At run time require exact registered PIT-B/RESEARCH_CONDITIONAL or DERIVE_ONLY dependency semantics plus the exact CY-051 asset and bounded authorization. Re-hash the registry before publication. This freeze and its repository-side registry suggestion do not modify the central registry or authorize a run.

cy051_authorization_envelope.activation: The runner must fail before touching source artifacts unless the central registry independently contains the exact suggested CY-051 asset and authorization bound to the completed spec, runner, manifest and source identities.

corporate_action_id_contract.v35_strictness: Before a historical action step can enter the MAX diagnostic, empty, padded or duplicate action-ID members fail the step closed; the strict parsed member count must equal corporate_action_count.

frozen_mother_signal.decision_schedule: The first completed Friday exchange session in each calendar month. A month with no Friday session produces no decision.
frozen_mother_signal.decision_at: Completed signal-session t close. Every signal input must have available_at no later than decision_at.
frozen_mother_signal.universe: Historical Main Board and ChiNext identities only: 600/601/603/605.SH and 000/001/002/300/301.SZ. Require non-ST, trade_status=1, current-day tradable, nonblank PIT industry and all CY-006 hard/bar/trading-state/industry/float/corporate-action/market/market-rule/historical-identity gates true, with nonblocking corporate actions and nonblank required snapshot IDs.
frozen_mother_signal.current_numeric_validity: Raw close, preclose, amount, volume, turnover_fraction and circulating_shares must be finite and strictly positive.
frozen_mother_signal.signal_day_action_exclusion: corporate_action_count must equal zero, the strict action-ID aggregate must be empty, corporate_action_blocking must be explicitly false, and the accepted action coordinate must have share_multiplier=1 and cash_per_share=0. CY-006 rights_ratio is optional-zero: only a true null or a finite numeric zero may represent economic zero, and only in conjunction with every other no-action gate. A non-null nonnumeric value, nonfinite value or nonzero value fails closed. Unknown or inconsistent action state fails closed.
frozen_mother_signal.amount_floor: On each decision date, compute the median current CNY amount across the entire otherwise-eligible Main Board and ChiNext cross-section. A rankable stock must have current amount greater than or equal to that same-date median. The floor never enters ticket ordering.
frozen_mother_signal.size_neutralization: After the amount floor, within each decision-date/PIT-industry group of at least 12 stocks, deterministically NTILE(3) by circulating_market_value_cny ascending then symbol. Only tercile 2 is rankable.
frozen_mother_signal.selection: Within each rankable date/industry middle-size tercile, select exactly the stock with minimum board_lot_ticket_cny. Break ticket ties by larger current amount, then lexical symbol.
frozen_mother_signal.cooldown: Process selected rows by signal date, PIT industry and symbol. Retain a stock only when its global signal calendar index is strictly more than 60 exchange sessions after its last retained V35 event.
frozen_mother_signal.earliest_hypothetical_fill: A later legal open, never session t. Stage A does not read or evaluate a fill.

prior20_max_redundancy_coordinate.step_return: Causal log close-to-close return. A zero-action step requires an explicitly known zero count, empty strict action-ID aggregate, explicit nonblocking state, share_multiplier=1 and cash_per_share=0, then uses raw close_t/raw close_t-1. For rights_ratio only, true null or finite numeric zero is canonical optional-zero; non-null nonnumeric, nonfinite or nonzero fails the step. A causally available non-rights QD-010 action step requires a strict action-ID member count exactly equal to corporate_action_count and uses close_t divided by ((close_t-1-cash_per_share)/share_multiplier), with the same optional-zero rights rule. Every invalid, noncontiguous, blocking, unknown, duplicate-ID or actual-rights step is null.
prior20_max_redundancy_coordinate.window: Twenty close-to-close steps ending at t, using 21 contiguous session endpoints t-20 through t inclusive. A missing diagnostic never changes candidate identity.
prior20_max_redundancy_coordinate.orientation: Higher MAX means more lottery-like recent upside; no orientation is authorized as a V35 filter.

allowed: verify exact frozen file hashes and CY-006/QD-010/QD-012 registry semantics
read only exact 2018, 2019 and 2020 CY-006 partitions
construct the completed-close monthly universe, amount floor, middle size tercile, lowest-ticket identity and 60-session cooldown
write an outcome-free pre-cooldown representation and retained candidate table
report count, date, industry, symbol, PIT, snapshot and corporate-action audits
report non-filtering rank/collision diagnostics between ticket cost and circulating size, amount, turnover and causal prior-20 MAX

redundancy_diagnostics.rankable_pool: Within-date/PIT-industry fractional-rank associations for board-lot ticket versus circulating market value, amount, turnover fraction and available prior-20 MAX.
redundancy_diagnostics.selected_rows: Distribution of selected stocks' deterministic average fractional ranks for circulating size and amount within the full otherwise-eligible date/PIT-industry group before the amount floor, plus identity collision with deterministic same-pool lowest circulating-size and lowest prior-20-MAX representatives.
redundancy_diagnostics.decision_role: Descriptive redundancy challenge only. No association may add, remove, reorder or rescue a V35 event during Stage A.

forbidden: any price, return, state, entry, target, exit or outcome after signal session t
any future payoff, MFE, MAE, hit label, chart path, outcome bucket or portfolio artifact
any 2021-plus partition, signal identity or outcome
any existing strategy trade, candidate outcome or result artifact
a high-ticket alternative, parameter grid, neighboring schedule, alternate tercile, threshold rescue, market regime or added price-path filter

stage_a_opportunity_gate.failure_policy: If semantic/PIT/input gates pass but any annual opportunity gate fails, publish only the Stage-A count audit as FAILED_OPPORTUNITY_GATE_PERMANENTLY_CLOSED. Do not inspect charts, outcomes or alternative definitions.

later_stage_boundary_not_authorized.chart_window_if_stage_a_passes: A separately frozen asset may render signal-126 through signal+126 only after Stage-A identity audit.
later_stage_boundary_not_authorized.fixed_economic_hurdle_if_a_rule_is_later: +10% target, H20 lifecycle, 40 bps round-trip cost; every year must have more than 50 completed signals and mean net return greater than 4%.

output_contract.write_policy: Build in a sibling staging directory, verify every frozen input again, refuse an existing canonical path, and atomically rename without overwrite. Semantic/PIT/input failure publishes nothing. A pure opportunity failure publishes one compact permanent-close result.json and never publishes either Parquet identity table.

next_action: Independently audit the corrected spec, completed runner, CY-051 manifest and registry suggestion. Only after a separate change installs the exact suggestion in the central registry may Stage A run once without opening any outcome.
